matches_layer_note: The `id` field is the REGISTRY-layer spelling -- the id as stored in cache/registry/part-*.bin, which is what reconcile() matches. It is minted by registry-manager.js mergeCurrentBatch via getNodeSource(), which returns "hf" for EVERY dataset regardless of the record's own source, so a Kaggle dataset is stored as hf-dataset--<tail>. `export_layer_id` is the SAME record as spelled in merged_shard_*.json.zst / state/processing-shards, minted by merge-batches.js from entity.source ("kaggle"). Schema v1 embedded the EXPORT-layer ids and could therefore never match the registry; run 31563250233 self-abandoned on 274 missing / 274 extra with an exact tail bijection. Both spellings are recorded here so a layer confusion cannot recur silently.

note: Public dataset identities already present in the public corpus. IDENTITY ONLY - no record content, no tag values. census_bytes is the 08-09 EXPORT-layer record size and is CONTEXT, never a gate: the registry record serialises differently, so only the ID SET is matched one-for-one.
